summary.title: SecureNova AI Identity Security
summary.description: SecureNova Inc. operates an AI-powered customer service platform using Auth0 for identity management. Authenticated human users interact with an AI agent that invokes internal REST APIs, retrieves knowledge through a RAG pipeline, and calls MCP server tools. The threat model evaluates authentication, authorization, credential exposure, identity spoofing, privilege escalation, prompt injection, RAG poisoning, and audit risks.

threats.title: OIDC Identity Spoofing
threats.description: An attacker may impersonate a legitimate user by abusing stolen, forged, or replayed OIDC authentication artifacts.
threats.mitigation: Use Authorization Code Flow with PKCE, validate issuer/audience/signature/nonce, enforce MFA where appropriate, and reject expired or replayed tokens.

threats.title: OIDC Token Information Disclosure
threats.description: Access or identity tokens may be exposed through insecure browser storage, logs, URLs, or client-side telemetry.
threats.mitigation: Use secure token handling, avoid sensitive tokens in URLs/logs, apply least-privilege scopes, and protect browser storage and transport with HTTPS.

threats.title: Authentication Service Denial of Service
threats.description: Repeated authentication requests or abuse of the login endpoint could degrade availability of the authentication service.
threats.mitigation: Apply rate limiting, bot protection, anomaly detection, resilient authentication infrastructure, and monitoring for abnormal login traffic.
